$comment: Operator details for the Privacy, Terms and Contact pages (/privacy/, /terms/, /contact/). Values in [BRACKETS] are placeholders the owner must replace; the texts are drafts that need legal review before launch. While any placeholder remains, the prod variant publishes neither these pages nor Google Analytics (analytics needs a published privacy policy); the dev variant shows the drafts with a 'Draft' notice. See docs/LAUNCH.md.
